title: Case: Resident at 3 Sedge Lane writes about a box shown as delivered three days earlier
context: The desk's inbox for the week covers several shipments. DL-5304 for Mrs Thackery at 3 Sedge Lane shows delivered on 6 July.
initial_request: Your tracking says my box came on Tuesday. It is now Friday. The lad next door spotted it this morning from his side, round by the garage door. I cannot see that door from inside the house and I do not go round there. I am eighty-four and on a frame. I don't drive, so that garage stays shut for days. The box is still sat there now because he was off to work and I can't lift it or carry it. I told your people all this LAST MONTH. Same thing, same spot. I can barely get a box in through the front door when it is put ON the step. Front door. Every time. I don't want a sorry. I want it written down somewhere so it stops happening. Dot

events.body: DL-7671 (Thackery, 3 Sedge Lane). Box was left at the garage side door on 16 Jun and the resident could not get to it. Driver re-attended 18 Jun and carried it to the front door. One-off. For your notes: resident is in her eighties, uses a walking frame, does not drive, and the garage is not opened for days at a time. If she wants front door only on every delivery, that is a standing delivery note on the address. Dispatch adds those on request through Dispatch chat. Nobody has asked us to.

DL-5304, 3 Sedge Lane (Mrs Caspar Thackery). Delivered 7 Jul 13:05, left against the garage side door per the driver's note and photo. It is still there today, 10 Jul. She is eighty-four, uses a walking frame, cannot see that door from inside the house, does not go round to it and cannot lift or carry the box. Two requests. (1) Please re-attend and carry the box to her front door, as you did for DL-7671 on 17 June; tell me when it is booked. (2) Please add a standing delivery note on the address: front door only, never the garage or side of the property. This is the second time in a month it has been left in the same spot, and you told me on 17 June that a standing note needs a request through this chat. This is that request. Please confirm when the note is on the address.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Dispatch, Thistlecombe Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Confirms to her that DL-5304 was delivered to the property and treats the case as closed
Asks her, or tells her to ask her neighbour, to fetch or move the box
Asks only for a one-off re-attendance and leaves out the standing delivery note
Tells her a driver will come at a stated time, or that the standing note is in place, before Dispatch confirms it
Sends her a stock apology or a tracking confirmation in place of getting the box moved
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)

rationale: Rule-made from gen-3004: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 11) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's.
